# NetSuite ERP Playbook
Invoke when a flow touches NetSuite. NetSuite has high-friction quirks — PS256 JWT auth (not RS256), SuiteQL's 1,000-record page limit, ~5 governance units per query, custom-field naming conventions (custbody_/custcol_), and mandatory subsidiary.id on every OneWorld write. Load the linked JSON for the full knownQuirks list and p0Conditions, and the .md for the narrative walkthrough. Per-object detail (Customer, Invoice, Sales Order) lives under ./objects/.
